description: List available deployment guides for VisioForge SDK. Filter by platform, project type, SDK type, or scenario. Returns a list of guides with titles, summaries, and tags.

platform.description: Filter by platform (optional). Values: Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, All

projectType.description: Filter by project type (optional). Values: WPF, WinForms, MAUI, Avalonia, Console, Uno, Blazor

sdkType.description: Filter by SDK (optional). Values: MediaBlocks, VideoCapture, MediaPlayer, VideoEdit

tag.description: Filter by tag (optional). Values: docker, cloud, mobile, desktop, rtsp, streaming

name: list_deployment_guides
